notHosted.cursor: cursor-agent adds a marketplace only from a GitHub-style https URL and installs plugins from the UI, so no install from a hosted catalog has been verified.
notHosted.antigravity: Antigravity registers no marketplace: its plugins are directories under .agents/plugins/.
notHosted.kimi: The marketplace layout builds no catalog, and Kimi installs a plugin directory through its web server, so there is no Git ref to install from.
